about.legislature: Congress of the Union: Chamber of Deputies (500) and Senate (128)

offices.President: Elected for a single six-year term by plurality vote in one round. Re-election is not allowed.
offices.Chamber of Deputies: 300 deputies are elected in districts and 200 from regional party lists. The whole chamber is renewed every three years.
offices.Senate: Each state elects three senators, two for the winning list and one for the runner-up, plus 32 from a national list. Terms are six years.

elections.system: 128 seats: three per state and 32 proportional
